name: University of Maine 4-H Camp & Learning Center at Bryant Pond – Summer Camp
description_short: A 4-H summer camp run by the University of Maine in the mountains of Western Maine. Most programs run Sunday to Friday and cover topics such as wilderness survival, shooting sports, conservation, outdoor adventure and teen leadership. Day camp weeks are also offered.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page mentions canoeing and swimming at the camp waterfront, depending on the program. It gives no details on swim tests or lifeguards.

warnings: This is a general overview page. It lists no dates, prices or ages, and no season year is stated, so season_year is left blank.
The camp offers both overnight programs (Sunday to Friday) and separate 'Day Camp Weeks'. camp_type is set to sleepaway because that is the main format, but it is inferred and not stated outright.
The phone number on the page (207.581.3188 / 800.287.0274) is for the main University of Maine Cooperative Extension office in Orono, not clearly the camp, so it was not recorded.
Program details are on subpages (Day Camp Weeks, program paths, Search by Week/Age, FAQ) that were not part of this source.
